# Lore

A short guide to the story and how the game delivers it. The story itself, what is
really going on, the cast and the tone are in `docs/story/01-story-bible.md`; every line
with its id is in `docs/story/03-ingame-text.md`.

## The story, briefly

Under the Halden Building there is a stair that is not on the plans, and below it the
Understory: the place a building forgets. Six survey crews went down to map it. The
player is Crew 7, called only "Seven", carrying the rig Ines Calder built: it does not
make light, it makes a record. Nobody explains what the dark is, why the monsters were
once people, why the sign-in sheet says Crew 7 came in "again", or why every time the
dark takes you, you wake at the last lit room. The player puts it together.

## How the game tells it

The game never lectures. Everything comes from things that exist in the world, written
by people who assumed the reader already knew:

| Where | What the player meets |
| --- | --- |
| Lit rooms | A lit break after every level: small havens with one page each, big rooms with three or four (sign-in sheets, tapes, a corkboard, a guest book). Read at a prompt. |
| Hidden recorders | Scan one enough and it reveals itself and plays the next tape, in story order. |
| Manual pages | The rare gold page in a maze: one numbered rule from the survey manual, with the crew's margin notes. |
| The radio | Base reports and counts. Near a disguised Echo a false Base gives directions; real Base never does. |
| Hints | Staff notices and manual rules, with the control for your device in brackets. |
| The field guide | The manual's page for each monster you have met, then its plain rule. |
| The finale | Ines, in the Lamp Room, and a choice. |

### The Relay

Endless floors past tier 8 are Relay floors; every few of them there is a lit landing.
The daily run is *TONIGHT'S FLOOR*, *same for everyone*.

#### Lit room: RELAY FLOOR

*lit once before*

**Poster**

> IF YOU CAN READ THIS,\
> SOMEONE LIT IT FIRST.

**Poster**

> THANK YOU, TWO NIGHTS AGO.

**Note by the kettle**

> CREW 8: THE KETTLE WORKS.\
> TEA IS IN THE TIN.

## Manual pages

Found in the maze, one per run at most, titled "Manual page". Page 12 is in the Lamp Room.

> 1. Personnel will wake in low light.\
> This is normal.

> 2. The rig does not produce light.\
> It produces a record.\
> In the margin: a dot stays where you looked. -J.B.

> 3. White: structure. Green: crew.\
> Red: unaccounted for.

> 4. Every pulse is audible.\
> Quiet is a resource. Budget it.\
> In the margin: ask Tobi. -I.C.

> 5. Do not run toward a sound\
> you cannot place.

> 6. Base reports. Base counts.\
> Base does not give directions.\
> In the margin: she means it. -I.C.

> 7. Crew greet with two taps.\
> Then wait. Then one.\
> In the margin: anything that skips the wait is not crew. -R.A.

> 8. If a bag is glowing,\
> someone wanted it found.\
> In the margin: that was me. -J.B.

> 9. Follow the water.\
> It always ends somewhere lit.\
> In the margin: nobody believed it. it was true. -L.S.

> 10. Some things move only when unobserved.\
> In the margin: watch, then step. never stare. -M.Q.

> 11. Personnel who fail to return\
> will wake at the last lit room.\
> In the margin: that is not luck.\
> In the margin: it is her. -T.W.

## The radio

**Base**, on a new floor: "Base to Seven. Floor {floor}. Counting."

On the first visit to the Night Desk: "Base to Seven. Lamp is holding. Base to Seven. Floor B3 is quiet."

After a level is cleared: "Base to Seven. Logged."

Now and then in the dark:

- "Base to Seven. I can see you."
- "Base to Seven. One. Two. Three. Still here."

When the dark gives you back:

- "Welcome back. Breathe. You are lit."
- "Back at the last lamp. Good."
- "Easy. Easy. Count with me."

**Base?**, only close to an Echo that is still pretending:

- "Seven. This way. Come toward my voice."
- "Put the rig down, Seven. It is safe here."
- "Base to Seven. Turn left. Left. Now."
- "Two taps. (tap tap) ...Seven?"

## The monsters

**the Pacer** (wanderer)

> THE PACER\
> Walks the same rounds every night.\
> Keys on a ring.\
> In the margin: he was a custodian. he is still working. -I.C.

**the Hush** (listener)

> THE HUSH\
> No eyes. Hears everything.\
> Pulses and footsteps draw it.\
> In the margin: walk. do not run. do not ping. -T.W.

**the Echo** (mimic)

> THE ECHO\
> Reads as crew. Answers every call.\
> In the margin: it cannot wait. -R.A.

**the Still** (stalker)

> THE STILL\
> Moves when it is not seen.\
> In the margin: watch, then step. never stare. -M.Q.

## The finale

Reading the last page in the Lamp Room brings Ines. She counts the times the dark took
you (the line changes if it never did), then asks.

**Ines**, for a player who was taken three times:

> Seven. Good.\
> The dots held.
>
> Every time the dark took you,\
> I pulled you back to the last light.
>
> 3 times.\
> Each night a little further.
>
> The whole map held tonight.\
> Look. All of it.
>
> The ladder goes up.\
> Pim made it. So can you.
>
> Or sit with me a while.\
> Someone has to keep the lamp.

**Climb the ladder.** ends that player's run and returns them to the title,
checkpoint kept:

> The air changes first.\
> Then sound. Then a colour you forgot.\
> Up here, it is morning.\
> THE UNDERSTORY: MAPPED

**Take the lamp.** carries on through the Lamp Room's door into the Relay:

> The lamp is heavier than it looks.\
> Down here, the dark is only unfinished.\
> Somebody will wake and need a light.\
> THE RELAY
